notes: Snapshot describes implementation heads. Goal/progress/handoff documentation is committed afterward on the same navigation feature branch.
Frozen experiment runtimes differ across experiment generations. Consult linked reports rather than treating all runs as the final binary.
No new or linked development worktree was used; no robot motion or LCM commands were sent.

localization: Two density experiments: 90 initialization processes; development improvement does not cancel new-position failures.
Exact-scan warm-LIO: 18 processes; cold and warm both 0/9 correct initialization.
Yaw diagnostics: 3 processes; additional TopK/yaw factorial variants: 9 processes; all four settings 0/3 correct initialization.
LIO configuration: 8 invalid inputs rejected, valid angle smoke passed, 243-pose default regression.
Loop optimization: 4 fault/recovery tests passed; ordinary full SLAM regression produced 15 finite keyframes and 8 anchors; no recorded loop event in that regression.
Descriptor: 5 C++ tests; offline warm-entry misuse: 6 checks; scoring: 5 checks; curve analysis: 4 checks.
Target measurement tool: 2 tests, actual x86 platform rejection, explicit host smoke only.
navigation: Joint build passed. Authority 8, BackUp 6, BT 9, gate 25, phase 11, independent Python audit 32, scene 2 tests passed.
Navigation matrix: geometry/phase 8/8; old combined audit 7/8. Final two serial TRACK runs geometry/phase/callback passed, strict DDS audit unscorable.
BackUp final 19 trials: action expectation 18/19, budget/geometry 19/19, strict combined 1/19; 17 DDS unscorable and one recorded-map action failure.
Delayed-odometry trials: 0.170633479, 0.169885713, 0.170474898 m paths within 0.2 m, stopped at success. No dt clipping during those actions.

remaining_risks: Unresolved pd1 initialization failures at new positions; reference is not independent ground truth; missing negative-map/route acceptance.
Publisher interval audit needed; current 100 us local-publish quality gate leaves strict DDS runs unscorable; historical callback failures retained.
Recorded-map BackUp aborted on stale odometry; complete automatic recovery BT trigger and dynamic rear obstacle during braking not verified.
Plant caps dt at 0.1 s and applies watchdog at callback end; not full wall-time or physical actuator dynamics. Same-TRACK curvature lag remains.
Model home footprint is not measured gait/payload envelope. RK3588 budget/native target ROS build and actual SDK stop/watchdog/routes not verified.
